working: PCl5 has 5 bond pairs and no lone pairs (sp3d), so it is trigonal bipyramidal (III). BrF5 has 5 bond pairs and 1 lone pair (sp3d2), so it is square pyramidal (IV). BF4- has 4 bond pairs on sp3 boron, so it is tetrahedral (I). [Ni(CN)4]2- is Ni2+ (d8) with strong-field CN-, giving dsp2 hybridisation, so it is square planar (II). Hence A-III, B-IV, C-I, D-II, which is option 2.
